facts.text: An exclusive-use gate gives Little Kulala guests direct access to the Sossusvlei dunes and Dead Vlei.
facts.excerpt: An exclusive-use gate provides direct access to the renowned dunes of Sossusvlei and the evocative panoramas of Dead Vlei.

facts.text: Little Kulala lies on 27,000 hectares of the Kulala Wilderness Reserve.
facts.excerpt: Little Kulala lies on 27,000 hectares of the pristine Kulala Wilderness Reserve.

facts.text: The reserve land was once farmland used for subsistence goat farming, with very little indigenous wildlife left.
facts.excerpt: Once upon a time, the farmland here was used for subsistence goat farming, with very little indigenous wildlife left.

facts.text: Some 30 years ago Wilderness pushed to protect the landscape, returning the land to its natural state.
facts.excerpt: Some 30 years ago Wilderness pushed to protect the ancient landscape, returning the land to its former glorious natural state.

facts.text: The camp's decor echoes the local geology, reflecting the surrounding grey and pink limestone.
facts.excerpt: Little Kulala’s décor echoes the local geology, reflecting the surrounding grey and pink limestone

facts.text: The camp is totally solar-powered, with modern lines that open out to the desert.
facts.excerpt: Totally solar-powered, the modern lines of this Namibian camp open out to the desert

facts.text: Each suite has its own private pool.
facts.excerpt: Your suite’s private pool is where we’re sure to find you enjoying lazy afternoons

facts.text: Each suite has a rooftop for private sundowners and suppers.
facts.excerpt: while your rooftop invites private sundowners and suppers.

facts.text: A roll-out bed on the suite's shaded deck can be used for a siesta or a night's sleep outdoors.
facts.excerpt: A roll-out bed on your shaded deck is perfect for a siesta, or heavenly night’s sleep.

facts.text: The Star Bed can be rolled under cover if wind or rain arrives.
facts.excerpt: The Star Bed can be rolled under cover if wind or rain arrives.

facts.text: Little Kulala was recently refurbished.
facts.excerpt: Recently refurbished, Little Kulala effortlessly embraces its Namib vistas.

facts.text: Menus highlight indigenous produce such as Namibian dates, eembe fruit, venison, millet and local beans.
facts.excerpt: At Little Kulala our menus highlight indigenous produce. Sample Namibian dates, eembe fruit, venison, millet, and local beans.

facts.text: Guests can have an oasis lunch in a dry river bed in the desert.
facts.excerpt: Indulge in a delicious oasis lunch in a dry river bed in the desert.

facts.text: There is a wine cellar for a private dinner for two.
facts.excerpt: Retreat to the wine cellar for a romantic dinner for two.

facts.text: Activities include nature walks and drives, e-bikes and low-impact quad bikes.
facts.excerpt: See the desert come alive on nature walks and drives, e-bikes, or low-impact quad bikes.

facts.text: Guests can climb the 300-metre red dunes and look over the Namib Sand Sea World Heritage Site.
facts.excerpt: Climb the 300-metre red dunes and gaze upon the famed Namib Sand Sea World Heritage Site.

facts.text: Guests can hike through Sesriem Canyon.
facts.excerpt: Hike through Sesriem Canyon with a breathtaking perspective on the gorge formed aeons ago.

facts.text: After-dark walks reveal creatures such as scorpions glowing under UV light.
facts.excerpt: Walks reveal captivating creatures, such as scorpions aglow under UV light

facts.text: Desert-adapted wildlife includes ostriches, springbok, gemsbok, black-backed jackals, bat-eared foxes, perhaps an aardwolf, and Namibia's endemic dune lark.
facts.excerpt: Spot desert-adapted wildlife such as ostriches, springbok, gemsbok, black-backed jackals, bat-eared foxes, perhaps an aardwolf, or Namibia’s endemic dune lark.

facts.text: Stargaze in one of the darkest places on Earth.
facts.excerpt: Stargaze in one of the darkest places on Earth, contemplating space, and your place in it.

facts.text: Guided stargazing through the constellations is offered.
facts.excerpt: Be guided through the majestic constellations.

facts.text: The fully inclusive rate covers accommodation, all meals, twice-daily camp activities, park fees, laundry and local drinks, except premium imported brands and champagne.
facts.excerpt: The fully inclusive rate covers your accommodation, all meals, twice-daily camp activities, park fees, laundry, and all local drinks with the exception of premium imported brands and champagne.

facts.text: Hot air balloon flights launch at dawn from near Sesriem, about 45 minutes from camp.
facts.excerpt: hot air balloon flights over the Namib Desert operate at dawn from near Sesriem, approximately 45 minutes from camp.

facts.text: Balloon flights must be booked well in advance and are subject to weather.
facts.excerpt: Balloon flights must be booked well in advance and are subject to weather

facts.text: The quickest way to reach this remote part of Namibia is by light aircraft with Wilderness Air.
facts.excerpt: the best and quickest way to reach this remote part of Namibia is by light aircraft with Wilderness Air

facts.text: The camp has a spacious family unit.
facts.excerpt: A spacious family unit ensures complete privacy.

facts.text: The area lies in the south of the Namib Desert, in the Namib-Naukluft National Park, where salt and clay pans are surrounded by high red dunes.
facts.excerpt: In the south of Namibia’s ancient Namib Desert, in the Namib-Naukluft National Park, salt and clay pans are surrounded by high dunes, stained red by their iron oxide coating.
